title: Simultaneous small-strain creep and cyclic plasticity
summary: One fixed-old-state simultaneous creep/J2 or creep/Chaboche update, lowered through the ordinary physical-time implicit creep Step. The bounded serial 3D composition preserves separate creep/plastic histories, consistent tangent, accepted-temperature input, cutback, energy channels and joint checkpoint continuation.

science.statement: Solve both mechanisms within the same backward-Euler increment. Every local and global trial starts from the same accepted histories; backstress and creep flow need not be coaxial. This is not a one-pass split or sequential plastic and creep Steps.

equations.label: condensed local residual
equations.description: P is the complete existing plastic return at fixed old plastic state z; f is the creep flow rate. Mandel coordinates preserve tensor contraction.

equations.label: consistent tangent
equations.expression: (\mathbf I+\Delta t\,\mathbf C_p\mathbf L)\mathbf C=\mathbf C_p
equations.description: Cp is the plastic algorithmic tangent and L is the creep flow derivative at the converged local state. Residual-only backtracking does not need a tangent; final tangent evaluation is unchanged.

inputs.name: shared elasticity and separate rate/plastic branches
inputs.unit_role: one consistent stress and physical-time system
inputs.description: Both branches must share constant E and nu. Optional thermal expansion and Arrhenius power-law dependence come through the creep material, not a second incompatible elastic asset.

inputs.name: physical-time loading and temperature
inputs.type: amplitude, positive duration and optional scalar/field/accepted FieldHistory
inputs.unit_role: physical time and positive kelvin temperature
inputs.description: Temperature is sampled at attempted physical time and restored on rejected increments. The Sinh rate does not infer Arrhenius dependence.

outputs.name: S, CE, CEEQ, PE, PEEQ and ALPHA when present
outputs.description: Plastic and creep history remain distinct. Output cell recovery does not replace raw point identity.

outputs.name: work, storage and dissipation
outputs.description: Distinguish creep work, plastic work, hardening storage, modeled dissipation and backward-Euler contributions; do not call all work stored energy.

assumptions: Small strain, serial 3D, one homogeneous material; spatial fields may be nonuniform.
Constant shared elastic and plastic parameters; power-law or Sinh creep and optional existing thermal strain.
Quasi-static global equilibrium with one joint accepted state.
conventions: Use studies.creep_solid and ordinary model.step, not a new coupled Model or a project-owned solver.
Fixed-old-state local probes and staged full-array validation precede trial publication.
maximum_inelastic_increment checks both equivalent creep and plastic increments.
Serial checkpoint continuation preserves both branches and all backstresses; portable file format alone does not authorize rank-changing execution.
applicability: Bounded synthetic hold/reversal and prescribed-temperature studies with an explicitly selected material law.
Independent material-point tangent, global equilibrium, time/mesh refinement and restart verification.
limitations: No joint MPI, regional material composition, axisymmetry, finite strain or contact admission.
No temperature-dependent plastic parameters, cyclic softening or static backstress recovery; plastic-flow-driven dynamic recovery is not static recovery during a hold.
No constitutive damage feedback or calibrated service-life prediction. Separate creep/fatigue postprocessors do not change stiffness.
Mechanical energy bookkeeping excludes imposed thermal transfer and is not a full first-law certificate.
The nonuniform Arrhenius reference prescribes temperature and isolates rate dependence; it does not verify heat feedback or nonproportional thermal-cyclic component behavior.

usage.minimal_example: Register constitutive.CreepPlasticityMaterial(creep=creep_law, plastic=plastic_law) on a studies.creep_solid model, then use model.step(target=u, duration=duration, temperature=temperature_history).solve_result().

validation_rules: Compare the complete discrete tangent against fixed-old-state directional differences on nonproportional material paths.
Recover pure-creep and pure-plastic limiting cases without advancing either history twice.
Check independent continuous uniaxial relaxation and nonuniform active-plastic/creep fields under refinement.
Check independently constructed rotating-stress paths under heating/cooling, including distinct Chaboche plastic and creep directions and backstress time refinement.
Force late returned-array and restart corruption failures; accepted state and previously valid response must remain unchanged.
Reject unsupported compositions rather than silently lower the material to elasticity.
Passing synthetic references establishes numerical evidence only, not alloy calibration or code-standard acceptance.
